Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic SILAC-based AP-MS (Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry) workflow to identify the SNX3 interactome. Acquisition is inferred as DDA based on the use of an Orbitrap Velos and the standard AP-MS/SILAC approach described.

scope: GFP was precipitated with GFP-trap beads (Chromotek) for 60 min.

GFP-expressing control cells were grown in unlabelled medium containing regular arginine and lysine (R0, K0). GFP-SNX3-expressing cells were grown in medium containing 13C6-arginine and 4,4,5,5-D4-lysine (R6, K4).
Cell lysates were cleared before GFP was immunoisolated using Chromotek GFP nanotrap beads at 4oC for 1 hour.
The co-immuno-precipitating proteins were subsequently identified through LC-MS/MS spectrometry.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment used SILAC-labeled RPE-1 cells and affinity purification (GFP-trap/nanotrap) to isolate the SNX3 interactome prior to LC-MS/MS analysis.
